youtube_description:
I wear a mouthpiece for cardio and weightlifting, and I started doing this back when I was doing jujitsu. My coach told me I had to wear one. I was afraid it would make my cardio worse, but it actually made my cardio better. It forced me to breathe through my nose.

The other reason I wear one is that my dentist told me I had dental damage from clenching my teeth too hard when weightlifting. So now I always wear a mouthpiece when I work out.

If you guys want to get started, I recommend the Shock Doctor Trash Talker. Mold it so it fits your teeth. It's real comfortable, and once I put it in, it puts me in workout mode. I know it's time to get serious.
